hook.head: Field File 28 · Virtue Profile Display

Your teacher, still stuck inside Canvas

hook.note: A card reader by the door with 13 only reads cards with proof on them. Can you build a virtue profile with real evidence?

opti.brief: She can't leave Canvas, so you build it. Show Mary McLeod Bethune's virtues and the evidence. Then send her one photo.
opti.desk: No headset? Use my desk. Play the game, then write 2 sentences for your teacher.

vr.look: A virtue is a strong, good character trait, like courage. Evidence is a real fact that proves it. Put the virtue books in the middle and the evidence around them.

groups.title: Two virtues and three pieces of evidence

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Classical in Filter environments. Click Classical Outdoor Classroom, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the profile
steps.html: Put the Courage book and the Community book in the middle. Around them, put the potatoes, the coin and the textbook. Each one is a piece of evidence.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Fit your whole build in the tablet. Click Take photo.

On the Canvas tab, pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 To fix it, send a new photo.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? See Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Put each piece of evidence closest to the virtue it proves best.

vr.full: One photo that shows both books with the three pieces of evidence around them.

studio.title: A Profile of Harry T. Moore
studio.look: A virtue profile has four parts: the leader, the virtue, the evidence, and an honest sentence. Each part has three choices.
studio.do: Tap a part. Pick the best choice for it.

game.done: Your profile is complete! A real leader, one virtue, and proof you can check.

choices.text: Harry T. Moore, a teacher in Brevard County
choices.why: Yes! A real person with a real record.
A profile is about a real person.

parts.name: Virtue
parts.q: Which virtue did his actions show?

choices.why: Yes! He kept working for voting rights even after he lost his job.
Being liked is not a virtue.

choices.text: He was the nicest man ever.
choices.why: That's an opinion, not a fact you can check.
That's a guess. It's not in the record.

choices.text: He helped thousands of Black Floridians sign up to vote.
choices.why: Yes! That's a fact you can check.

parts.name: Honest
parts.q: Which sentence is honest about leaders?

choices.text: Leaders were not perfect, but the evidence shows one strong trait.
choices.why: Yes! That's what a virtue profile says.
Nobody is perfect. Don't claim it.

frames.starter: The virtue this leader showed was ...

studio.full: Your game is done, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
